frame: ORIGINAL scene 02 (積込 / loading) settled hold = JourneyPort._scenes.world(391) with NO tOverride, so ambient time is fixed at 391/30 = 13.03333 s (hero-glue.js line 50: idle:function(){return one('w',S.world(391));} — the idle argument is ignored). Source: C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-hero-remake/original/js/hero-port-b.js, sceneWorld lines 1244-1388 (same function as scene 01). Stage 1920x1080, origin top-left. Camera cam = T_WORLD.camLoadX = 1900 (reached at frame 262 and clamped from there, line 1250). Every parallax group is translate(-cam*factor, 0), so SCREEN x = world x - 1900*factor: hill -228, deep -342, far -608, mid -988, main -1900, fence -2033; y is never shifted. GROUND line y = 880 (line 1146). All boxes below are SCREEN px, given as x-range and y-range (or x, y, w, h), computed by running the unchanged file in Node with a fake window (hero-flag.js sets JX_CLEAN_HERO=true, hero-port-a.js gives JRMAP) and walking the returned {t,a,c} tree with transform composition; then confirmed against Chromium renders of the same moments of the site clock (0 console errors). The tree has 1295 virtual nodes; the scene function costs about 0.56 ms/frame in Node (no DOM). IMPORTANT, and different from scene 01: the hold is a COMPLETELY FROZEN STILL. Scene 01's idle passes a running ambient clock; scene 02's does not, so during the hold nothing moves at all — not the clouds, not the birds, not the sun glow, not the tower beacon, not the truck idle bob, not the bay light rays. (For reference, if ambient time did run, 30 of the 1295 nodes would change: sun glow r, 7 cloud transforms + 1 cloud edge opacity, 4 bird transforms + 4 wing paths, the tower beacon opacity, 3 truck body transforms and the 9 bay ray-line opacities. viewer/timeline.js calls this out: SCHED.holdAmbient02 = false for the site.) Player facts: the entrance plays frames 185 -> 391 at ENTER_RATE 1.2 (36 frames/s, 5.722 s); AUTO_DWELL[1] = 7600 ms, so on the site clock scene 02 runs 7000..14600 ms, the entrance ends at ms 12722 and the frozen hold lasts 1.878 s. During the entrance ambient time is time = frame/30 + ambOff*(391-frame)/206 with ambOff = 1.86111 s carried over from scene 01's idle (hero-glue.js 47-50, 242), so ambient runs from t = 8.028 s at frame 185 to t = 13.033 s at frame 391 — 5.006 s of ambient over 5.722 s of real time, i.e. about 0.875x speed. If the visitor clicks into scene 02 instead of arriving sequentially, ambOff = 0 and the clouds start 1.86 s earlier. Desktop crop centre FOCUS_X[1] = 960; phones blend to CAM_M[1] (x 960->1180, y 690->700, zoom 1.12->1.16) — that is player camera, not scene art. ambientMotion.what: THE HOLD HAS NO AMBIENT MOTION AT ALL (the single most important fact about this scene)
ambientMotion.formula: hero-glue.js line 50: idle: function(){ return one('w', S.world(391)); } — no tOverride, so time = 391/30 = 13.03333 s on every idle frame. From ms 12722 to ms 14600 (1.878 s, about a quarter of the scene) the picture is a completely still image: clouds, birds, sun glow, tower beacon, truck idle bob and the nine bay light shafts are all frozen. Scene 01's idle does pass a running clock, so the hero visibly stops breathing when it reaches scene 02's settle. viewer/timeline.js names this (SCHED.holdAmbient02 = false). A diff of world(391, t) against world(391, t+3.37) shows that if the clock DID run, exactly 30 of the 1295 nodes would change — see the entries below for which.

time = frame/30 + ambOff*(391 - frame)/206, with ambOff = scene 01's idle length = 1.86111 s in autoplay (0 if the visitor clicks straight into scene 02). So t runs 8.0278 s -> 13.0333 s while 5.722 s of real time passes: ambient plays at about 0.875x and lands exactly on 391/30 so that the handover to scene 03 (renderMaster(391)) does not jump.

ambientMotion.what: Clouds drift right and wrap (entrance only)
Birds drift right, bob and flap (entrance only)
ambientMotion.formula: x = ((rx*2300 + t*(14 + rs*10)) mod 2580) - 140, screen x = x - 608 (speeds 21.38, 16.71, 19.77, 19.54 px/s). y = 120 + ry*190 + 9*sin(0.7t + 2.2i) (+-9 px, period 8.98 s). Wing flap: arc control y = -3.2 - 3.4*sin(7t + 1.9i) (period 0.90 s), times scale s = 0.85 + rs*0.5.
glow radius = 52*4.6 + (0.5 + 0.5*sin(0.55t))*52*0.15 = 239.2 .. 247.0 px, period 11.42 s (246.12 at the frozen hold). Halo, disc and ring are static.

ambientMotion.what: Tokyo Tower tip beacon blink (entrance only)
ambientMotion.formula: circle opacity = 0.2 + 0.8*(0.5 + 0.5*sin(pi*t)) = 0.2 .. 1.0, period 2 s (0.558 at the frozen hold), multiplied by the tower group opacity 0.95.

ambientMotion.what: Warehouse bay light shafts shimmer (entrance only)
ambientMotion.formula: each of the 3 shafts in each of the 3 bays: opacity = 0.35 + 0.3*sin(rayPhase*1.7 + bay*2.1 + j*2.6) with rayPhase = time and j the shaft index, so 0.05..0.65, period 3.70 s, each shaft on its own phase. Frozen values at the hold: bay 01 0.301 / 0.240 / 0.588, bay 02 0.120 / 0.646 / 0.072, bay 03 0.632 / 0.161 / 0.392. The wedge gradient itself does not move.

ambientMotion.what: Truck 1 idle bob (body only, entrance only)
ambientMotion.formula: body translate y (local units, x2 on screen) = run*sin(frame*1.15)*1.3 + (1-run)*(settleBob + 0.35*sin(1.4t)). Once truck 1 is parked at the dock (frame ~286 on, run = 0; settleBob = exp(-(f-62)/9)*... is long gone) it is 0.35*sin(1.4t) local = +-0.7 px on screen, period 4.49 s. Frozen at -0.397 px. Wheels and ground shadows never move.

ambientMotion.what: Trucks 2 and 3 idle bob (body only, entrance only)
ambientMotion.formula: idleBob(i) = 0.55*sin(1.3t + 1.9i) local units at scale 1.94 = +-1.07 px on screen, period 4.83 s, 1.9 rad apart. Frozen at truck 2 = -0.007 px and truck 3 = +1.012 px, so at the settled frame truck 3's body sits 1 px lower than truck 2's.

ambientMotion.what: Everything else is static even during the entrance
ambientMotion.formula: Buildings, windows, poles, wires, road, the warehouse's own fabric (wall, fascia, sign, roof, bay frames), the hill, the haze bands, the sky, the washes, the fence and the vignette have no time term at all. All the rest of the motion in scene 02 is choreography (a function of frame), not ambient.

ambientMotion.what: Player camera drift on narrow viewports only (outside the scene function)
ambientMotion.formula: Desktop: static crop centred on stage x 960 (FOCUS_X[1]). As the visible window narrows (mobT = clamp((1500 - boxW/scale)/880)), the crop blends toward CAM_M[1]: centre x 960 -> 1180, y 690 -> 700, zoom 1.12 -> 1.16 across the 7.6 s dwell with ease-in-out, exponentially smoothed (rate 2.6/s). Reduced motion: fixed at the midpoint. On a phone this slow push to the right is the ONLY movement during the frozen hold.

Camera x by frame: 200: -200, 204: -197.7, 208: -182.0, 212: -139.1, 216: -55.6, 220: 82.0, 224: 287.2, 228: 573.7, 232: 948.4 (peak speed ~99 px/frame here), 236: 1280.5, 240: 1524.7, 244: 1694.4, 248: 1803.3, 252: 1864.8, 256: 1892.4, 260: 1899.7, 262: 1900. shutter(i) = interpolate(frame, [266 + 14i, 266 + 14i + 28], [0, 1], easeOutCubic), so bay 01 lifts over frames 266-294, bay 02 over 280-308, bay 03 over 294-322 — a 14-frame stagger, each lift 28 frames (0.78 s) with a fast start and a soft landing. lift = easeOutCubic(open) * 106 local px (201.4 screen px). The warm interior gradient and the light wedge fade in with glow = easeOutCubic(clamp01((open-0.15)/0.85)), so each bay starts glowing once its shutter is 15% up. The render at ms 9600 catches bay 01 at 83% open with bays 02 and 03 still fully shuttered.

Each parcel runs parcelPose: 0-13% anticipation squash at the bay mouth (screen (327 / 783 / 1239), y 874) with its shadow under it; 13-56% an arc to the apron, apex 112 px above the start (y ~762), stretching 5% and tilting up to 2.5 deg, landing bottom-centre at (391 / 847 / 1303, 880); 56-66% landing squash 12%; 66-76% a small settle wobble; 76-100% a hop up and right (apex y 785) into the truck toward (437 / 893 / 1349, 860), clipped at the truck's rear edge so it vanishes into the box. Phase frames for bay 01 parcel 1: 308-314.0, 314.0-333.8, 333.8-338.4, 338.4-343.0, 343.0-354 (add the offsets above for the others). Because the parcels are painted after all three trucks, the bay 02 parcels fly visibly in front of truck 1's cab.

All three rear doors close together, linear 1 -> 0 over 11 frames (k = 0.818 at 384, 0.636 at 386, 0.455 at 388, 0.273 at 390, 0.1818 at 391, 0 at 393). The last parcel is still in the air until frame 390, so the close overlaps the end of the loading.

All three shutters fully up, all three bays glowing with their light wedges on the apron, the three trucks standing at bays 01/02/03 with their doors frozen 18% open, no parcels anywhere, no exhaust, pitch 0 on all three trucks, and from this frame on NOTHING moves until the scene ends at ms 14600.
